metadata.description: Claude Code mods that show your work items, tasks and sessions, for any tracker.

plugins.name: handily
plugins.description: Every handily mod in one install, and /handily to show which mods are installed and loaded.

plugins.name: item-toasts
plugins.description: A toast when a work item changes outside this session, at most one every 30 s.

plugins.name: quiet-items
plugins.description: One short row in place of each tracker write in the transcript.

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: A board of every local Claude Code session: state, task, worktree and time worked.

plugins.name: task-pane
plugins.description: A session task list that Claude and you share: model tools, /task commands and an optional pane.

plugins.name: workitems
plugins.description: Provider of one typed work item list over any tracker, for other handily mods.
